messages:
maya: ran a quick bench for llama2-70b (fp16 / int8) on h100 vs a100 across us-east/us-west/eu-west. toggled edge-route preference (nearest vs central). p50/p95 numbers surprised me — eu-west looks bad for a100-int8 when nearest routing is used. summary below.
arjun: nice, can you paste the raw numbers? did you control for warmup & KV cache priming?
maya: ```
Route,Region,HW,Quant,p50(ms),p95(ms),tokens/s
nearest,us-east,h100,fp16,45,120,220
central,us-east,h100,fp16,42,110,240
nearest,us-west,a100,int8,60,220,160
central,us-west,a100,int8,50,130,195
nearest,eu-west,a100,int8,70,300,140
central,eu-west,a100,int8,48,125,190
```
eva: whoa — eu-west nearest p95=300ms on a100-int8. any kernel variant differences?
maya: good catch. for h100 I used flash-attn-v2 + fused kernels. on a100 some layers fell back to cuBLAS GEMM (no fused kernels) -> kernel mismatch and tail. quant pipeline = GPTQ-int8.
sam: did you try longer warmup / bigger KV priming? tail could be cold KV shards across pops.
maya: ran 3 warmup requests + 4 prefix batches; spikes persisted. logs show for nearest->eu-west we still route through an extra central proxy in ~12% of requests due to stale route binding, adding ~1-2 RPC hops.
liam: @infra can we pull packet traces / flow logs for the eu-west run window? need to confirm extra hop.
infra-bot: Canary trace created: trace_id=tr-202-1739001240; spans show client -> edge-proxy-eu -> central-proxy -> gpu-pool-eu. Filed INF-4321 for misbinding.
arjun: for capacity planning: what's the effective throughput delta per GPU? need to size Dedicated pools if we keep nearest routing.
maya: rough numbers: a100 int8 central ~190 toks/s, nearest degraded ~140. h100 fp16 ~220-240. so to match qps, eu-west would need ~1.4x the a100 nodes when nearest routing hits fallback.
eva: :thinking_face: can we force kernel pinning for a100 (use optimized fused kernels) as a mitigation?
maya: prototyped kernel pin via runtime config `kernel_override: fused_gemm_v1` — dropped p95 by ~40% in eu-west on the bench, but uncovered rare quality/regression cases on a few prompts. needs eval sweep.
sam: ok next steps: 1) infra to fix route binding (INF-4321) 2) runtime to expose kernel pin toggle for canary 3) ML to run 24h stability sweep on eu-west a100 int8 + dataset of tricky prompts. owners?
maya: :thumbsup: I'll open a PR with the run scripts, raw csv, and a short readme for replay. link: https://redwood.internal/run/bench/1739001234
